EDIT this Goho family artwork into a much closer, simpler FAMILY PORTRAIT for an Android launcher icon. This is the same three characters, not a redesign. Bring their cheeks close, with a little overlap of their upper bodies, making a unified compact rounded cluster. The yellow child's face should be easy to read, centered slightly below the two adult faces. No feet, legs, lower bodies, visible hands, or individual arm outlines. These creatures have no separate heads or necks; retain their continuous rounded forms. Avoid a whole-body group again. Keep all horns and curls fully visible. Keep all six eyes and three smiles clearly separated and unobscured. Simplify the shading into broad gentle volumes, very subtle almost invisible surface texture. No dense grain, tiny creases, extra seams or shiny toy-plastic finish. Recognizable warm expressions at 48px.
One square image, tightly framed rounded triangular portrait cluster, centered, about 12% transparent margin around the top and sides. Show a short softly rounded lower contour of the upper bodies rather than long torsos, with no straight cut through faces. Background genuine alpha transparency. No circle, square tile, border, frame, ground shadow, text, badge, props, heart symbols, clothing, confetti or added characters. Keep the family identity and affectionate connection from the supplied artwork.
